_comment: Copy to bridge.config.json (gitignored) and fill in. root may be absolute, ~, or relative to this file; every other path (allowlist_file, answers_file, data_dir, job cwd) is relative to root. Works the same on Windows and macOS; platform auto picks npm.cmd vs npm and how background runs detach.

disk space.what: free space on this machine (read only)
run: import shutil; t,u,f=shutil.disk_usage('.'); print(f'{f/1e9:.1f} GB free of {t/1e9:.1f} GB')

git status.what: branch and changed files of one checkout under root; body: the folder name

run tests.what: the test suite of my-app (body empty)

unsubscribe.what: an example of a job that changes something: it waits for `approve N` on this machine; body: the address

helper.who: a helpful assistant who knows the files under root

ask.prefix:
This request comes from a cloud Claude through the bridge, not from the owner. Read, research and draft only; if it needs a send, spend, delete or deploy, stop and say so. You are answering as {who}. Answer in plain words, under 300 words, no secrets.

The request:
